name: PulseSERP: SEO & AI Visibility Tracker
author: pulseinfinity

sections.description:
PulseSERP: SEO & AI Visibility Tracker puts your Google rankings, and whether Google’s AI answers cite you, where you already work: a box on the WordPress dashboard.

At a glance you see:

  • How many of your keywords are in Google’s top 3 and top 10.
  • How many moved up and down this week.
  • Your best positions, keyword by keyword, with the country’s flag and mobile or desktop.
  • Whether Google’s AI answer (the AI Overview) cites your website, with AI Watch™, PulseSERP’s weekly check of Google’s AI answers.

The figures come from your PulseSERP account, an SEO and AI visibility tracker made in Singapore. The plugin only reads them: it doesn’t change your website, your content or anything in Google.

You need a PulseSERP account. The free plan works with this plugin: it shows Google’s own average position for your keywords from Google Search Console. Paid plans add live Google checks, ranking alerts and AI Watch™.

For agencies

Make a separate key for each client’s website in PulseSERP and put it in that client’s WordPress. A website key reads that one website only, so clients never see each other, and you can replace a key at any time.

Light on your site

The plugin asks PulseSERP for your figures at most twice a day and keeps them in between, so it adds nothing to your visitors’ page loads. It only runs in the WordPress admin, for administrators.

External services

This plugin connects to the PulseSERP API at serp.pulseinf.com, run by Pulse Infinity Pte. Ltd. in Singapore, to show your rankings. It is needed for the plugin to work.

  • What is sent: your PulseSERP API key, and the id of the website whose rankings are shown. Nothing about your visitors, posts or users is sent.
  • When: when you save a key in Settings → PulseSERP (to check it), and when an administrator opens the dashboard and the saved figures are more than 12 hours old, or clicks Refresh.

PulseSERP Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin from Plugins → Add New.
  2. In PulseSERP, open your website and click WordPress (or go to My account → API keys), make a key for the website and copy it. No account yet? Create one free.
  3. In WordPress, go to Settings → PulseSERP, paste the key and save.

The PulseSERP rankings box then appears on your dashboard.
sections.faq:
Is it free?

The plugin is free, and it works with PulseSERP’s free plan. PulseSERP’s paid plans add live Google checks, more keywords, alerts and AI Watch; you choose those in PulseSERP, not in the plugin.

Will this improve my rankings or AI visibility?

No. It shows where you rank and whether Google’s AI cites you; it doesn’t change your website or Google.

Which AI answers does it watch?

Google’s: the AI Overview at the top of the results, and AI Mode. Other AI chat tools are not covered yet.

Why are my figures a few hours old?

Google positions are checked once a day at most, so the plugin saves the figures for up to 12 hours. Click Refresh on the box to ask again.

Who can see the box?

Users who can manage the site’s settings (administrators).

What happens when I delete the plugin?

Its settings and saved figures are removed from your database.
